text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — I'm handing off oncall in ~30m. Joanna will shadow for the first 15m. Quick pass on access: VPN creds (2FA), pager binding, runbook link below. Flag any blockers now.

alex: Thanks — do contractors have pager access for tonight? @priya any FYI on policy?

priya: Contractors don't get permanent pager bindings. We can add temporary access via IAM for a limited window or use the escalation alias. Which contractor?

jamie: temporary access granted for @contractor_tom until 02:00 UTC. Added a note to the rotation sheet.

morgan: Can you drop the quick SSH/Grafana/VPN snippets here so I can grab them before the handoff?

jamie: sure — paste from runbook: 
```
SSH jump: ssh -i ~/.ssh/oncall_rsa oncall@jump.internal.redwood
Grafana: user oncall, password stored in 1Password entry "Oncall/Grafana"
Pager test: /usr/local/bin/pager-cli trigger --target oncall --message "handoff test"
```

lee: VPN quick command: 
```bash
openvpn --config ~/configs/redwood.ovpn --auth-user-pass ~/.vpn-creds
# then confirm access to jump: ssh oncall@jump.internal.redwood
```

priya: Reminder: if you see token-rate errors with the inference cluster, follow runbook step 4 to route to the low-priority fallback model. Also watch queue depth > 80.

alex: Did you run the pager test already?

oncall-bot: Pager test event sent to oncall at 2190123500 — status: DELIVERED

jamie: I ran the test and saw delivery. Left a short note in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (see "temporary access" section).

morgan: I'll monitor alerts for the first hour while you finish the admin handoff. If anything pops, page me directly.

jamie: Thanks — I'll DM rotation details and the escalation matrix to the oncall group. :thumbsup:
